subject: general
question: Nisha, who is Dileep's daughter, says to Deveshi, "Your mother Ritu is the younger sister of my father, who is the second child of Krishna". How is Krishna related to Deveshi?
solution:
From the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e20f8e463dec121ef2127ecd0e3d8451f6c05cbd529fd1b01640f5ba2298ffef.png] 

Your (Deveshi) mother Ritu is the younger sister of my (Nisha) father (Dileep), who is the second child of Krishna. Thus, the final family tree is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3647f667e7e7517ce334e2b68ed46379da88e1f4e4651c857591405f7084963e.png] 

Since the gender of Krishna is not specified here, thus, Krishna can be the maternal grandmother or the maternal grandfather of Devas. 

Therefore, from the given options, we can say that Krishna is the maternal grandfather of Deveshi.

Hence, Krishna is the maternal grandfather** **of Deveshi.
